description: Blair Eddins, candidate for NC House in District 94, has earned four out of four stars and a recommendation from Grass Roots North Carolina (GRNC), an all-volunteer organization "devoted to educating the public about trends which abridge the freedoms guaranteed by the Bill of Rights, and engaging in grassroots activism to preserve those freedoms."GRNC's recommendation and four-star rating are based on Blair Eddins' strong support of citizens' Second Amendment protections.
